title: CRA evidence index
description: evidence-index.json in the CRA output directory (CW_CRA_OUT), written atomically by cra/refresh.mjs after a run passes the preflight gate: every artifact the run left in the directory with its sha256, and the inputs the evidence was built from. cra/evidence-status.mjs reads generatedAt and inputs to decide whether the pack is current. Indexes written before the schema field was added carry none; the reader accepts them.

slice.description: The rollup's sliceId; null when the rollup could not be read.

steps.description: The same step outcomes refresh-status.json records.

inputs.description: Each evidence input as it stood after the steps ran. A feed (kev, epss) refreshes on its own clock, so its change alone does not make the pack stale.

path.description: Relative to the commitwork root when inside it; null when no path resolved.

error.description: Unreadable inputs only: the error code or message.

signed.description: Whether the run signed the durable evidence (an attestation key was present and signing was not disabled).

timestamp.description: The timestamp step: an RFC 3161 token (cra/timestamp.mjs) over each signature record attest sign wrote, then verified from disk. Indexes written before the step existed carry none; cra/evidence-status.mjs reads that as absent.

state.description: The worst record's state. absent with no records when the step did not run (no CW_TSA_URL, or nothing was signed).

reason.description: Why the state is not anchored; null when it is.

record.description: The signature record, relative to the CRA output directory. Its token is <record>.tsq + <record>.tsr.

genTime.description: The TSA's time for the token. Anchored and unanchored only.

tsa.description: The TSA certificate's subject. Anchored and unanchored only.

path.description: Relative to the CRA output directory.
